d1b_auto_v2_product_registry_audit.author_declared_sequence_motif_metadata_: Sequence motif tallies (0 introns, 0x 2A, 0 uATG, 0 foreign peptides) are author-declared staging metadata on the product definitions and are not independently recomputed by this verifier.

rare_event_and_stage0_gate_matrix_audit.arithmetic_precision: decimal.Decimal prec=80 strictly sound directed outward bounds (ln/exp at ordinary arguments and paired alternating Taylor -expm1 enclosure at small x < 1e-6; bounded 2M-bit exact rational decider + 260-digit outward enclosure; alpha_eta >= 0.05 when eta < 1.0)
rare_event_and_stage0_gate_matrix_audit.count_subgate_framing: All zero-event rare-event thresholds (D1-04 AP1903 U95 <= 1.0e-8 at N_eff = 299,573,226 PASS vs 299,573,225 HOLD; D1-08 HLA-C*03:04 & C5b-9 U95 <= 5.0% at N = 59 PASS [4.9508% display] vs N = 58 HOLD [5.0339% display / 5.0340% conservative ceil]) represent mathematical count subgate arithmetic only, conditional on validated recovery/eligible-fraction calibration, and supply no empirical safety clearance.

scenario_alias_deduplication_map.note: Joins the 5 frozen IIP-0034 bridge rows (W_BC1..W_BC5) 1-to-1 by exact scenario ID to W_U1, W_U2, W_U8, W_U11, and W_U12 across all 1,048,576 unrounded 2^(4N) joint states (max_abs_diff <= 1e-12) with exact equivalence-partition verification and dynamic distinct_core_scenario_laws.
